data.body: EVIDENCE (close): Gerrit change 2128 MERGED into main as 6f0c15a21c4 (rebased from 56690adc6e43; Change-Id I4507ddd4b4f3e7f36e4e0de3cd6c192ff19a4d58) with LLM-Review +1 (rebar review bot), Verified +1 (rebar CI bot), 0 unresolved comments. AC1: test_breadcrumb_emitted_live_path_zero_local_comments + test_append_once_against_live_fetched_set GREEN (RED verified on pre-fix code: breadcrumb list empty). AC2: client-None and fetch-failure tests GREEN (bug-4292 unknown-state safety preserved). CAUSE ANALYSIS (fix-site vs cause-site): the 'if not local_comments: return []' guard traces via blame -w -C -M to repo genesis b534f47a7f9b (carried from dso_reconciler/outbound_differ.py) where it was correct — nothing to compare, skip the fetch. It became a defect only when S7 (2c66-205d-92e1-4419, commit 105d6f682bd) appended the breadcrumb AFTER that guard without covering the live-search path — flagged as a non-blocking advisory on change 2091 and deferred here. Cause-site = the S7 plan's scope gap, hence close --class=plan_defect --caused-by=2c66-205d-92e1-4419.
